title: NamedQuery
description: A server-defined query in config/named_queries/ with one JSON DSL and one GQL spelling. The server renders the spelling the request selects and compiles it with the matching frontend. Each file name must match its name field.

name.description: Stable identifier clients invoke. Must match the YAML file stem.

description.description: One-sentence, introspection-facing summary of what the query returns.

default.description: When true, this query leads the catalog returned by ListNamedQueries so clients can preselect it. At most one query may set this.

bindings.description: Trusted server values, never client-supplied. JSON uses {$binding: name}; GQL uses binding("name").

schema.description: JSON Schema the client-supplied value must satisfy at render time.

example.description: Representative value substituted for build-time compilation against the ontology. Must satisfy schema.

parameters.description: Client values validated against JSON Schema. JSON uses {$param: name} for whole values and a "$param:name" object key for string parameters. GQL uses param("name") for encoded literals, identifier("name") for validated identifiers, and integer("name") for decimal Int64 IDs.

json.description: Query DSL object with {$binding: name}, {$param: name}, and "$param:name" placeholders replaced at render time.

gql.description: Trusted GQL text with MiniJinja lookup expressions. Authors must place each lookup at a complete literal or identifier position outside quotes, backticks, and comments, without removing its encoding.

query.description: Both spellings must select the same graph shape. The parity test in crates/integration-tests compiles them to identical SQL.
